// diagnostic

E2501

`{method}` is not available on a {direction} file handle.

What

`{method}` is not available on a {direction} file handle.

Why

`files.open` returns a read-only handle; `files.create`/`files.append` return a write-only handle. Calling a write method on a reader (or a read method on a writer) is a type error.

Fix

use the correct handle type for the operation: `files.open` to read, `files.create`/`files.append` to write.
